title: Kissed Crunchy Russian Cashew Bowl
description: A cultured and chewy Russian dish featuring cashews, render fat, and sugar free friendly ingredients, served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg, sour cream, salt, and black pepper.
Add the buckwheat groats, dried apricots, prunes, and chopped fresh dill to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Heat the render fat in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the cashews to the skillet and cook until lightly toasted, stirring frequently.
Add the toasted cashews to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into a Korean brass bowl.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
